_note: 2026-10-17: no verifiable ground photo available; a labelled Esri World Imagery satellite view of the airport is published instead.

aur-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：奥里亚克机场的跑道铺在法国中央高原的丘陵与农田之间，航站楼与机坪在跑道一侧。
aur-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: Aurillac's runway lies among hills and farmland on the Massif Central, with the terminal and apron alongside it.

aur-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 航站楼的浅色墙面上嵌着巨大的蓝色 AURILLAC 字母，旁边的小塔台立在一旁，头顶是蓝天白云。
aur-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Giant blue letters spelling AURILLAC sit on the terminal's pale wall, with the small control tower alongside and white clouds in a blue sky.

aur-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 这是一张带标注的卫星地图截图，标出奥里亚克-特龙基耶机场的跑道、机坪与南侧的太阳能板阵列。
aur-chatgpt-02.webp.en: A labelled satellite map screenshot marks out the runway, apron and a solar panel array south of Aurillac-Tronquières airport.

aur-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 旅客沿着舷梯从双发涡桨客机走下，在机坪上走向航站楼，旁边是玻璃指挥室的塔台与一辆红色消防车。
aur-chatgpt-03.webp.en: Passengers come down the airstairs of a twin-turboprop and cross the apron towards the terminal, past a glass-cabbed control tower and a red fire truck.

aur-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 航拍画面中是成片的平顶厂房与停车场，环形道路从中间穿过，四周是草地和树带，画面里看不到跑道。
aur-chatgpt-04.webp.en: This aerial frame shows rows of low flat-roofed buildings and car parks cut by a ring road, with grass and trees around and no runway in sight.

aur-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 雨后湿漉漉的机坪上，一架涂着 HOP! 标志的双发涡桨飞机正面停着，黄色引导线一直延伸向草地。
aur-chatgpt-05.webp.en: On a rain-soaked apron a twin-turboprop wearing the HOP! colours faces the camera, yellow guide lines running away towards wet grass.

aur-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 一架白色涡桨客机停在机坪上，机头旁停着一辆橙色拖拉机，机身侧面露出 HOP! 与法国航空的字样。
aur-chatgpt-06.webp.en: A white turboprop stands on the apron with an orange tractor parked by its nose, HOP! and Air France lettering showing along the fuselage.

aur-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 机坪上停着一架红白黄三色的轻型单发飞机，垂尾与机身上的编号清晰，远处是灰白天空下的低矮厂房。
aur-chatgpt-07.webp.en: A light single-engine aircraft in red, white and yellow stands on the apron, its registration clear on the tail, with low sheds under a grey sky beyond.
